notes.title: Localization update!
notes.content:
As requested, we've localized the game into a ton of new languages! Voices remain in English, but the game's entire UI can now be changed to accommodate the following languages:

[list]
[*]English
[*]Spanish
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Russian
[*]Chinese (Simplified/Traditional)
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Arabic
[/list]

Next up, we'll be working to improve character reactions! Stay tuned for that, pornstars! There's a bright future ahead!

notes.title: Preparing for release!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

It's nearly time to launch your porn career and fuck your way to the top of the industry! We've been [i]hard[/i] at work making America's Next Top Pornstar the best game we possibly can, and we can't wait for you to get the game -- [i]among other things ;)[/i] -- into your hands!

One of the biggest advancements we've made during our recent development is the addition of ray tracing, which creates much more lifelike and convincing lighting and shadows on machines that can support it. If you've got a graphics card that supports DLSS, you'll be able to take full advantage of both it and ray tracing to get the best visuals and performance when the game releases. Check out some comparisons below to see how drastically the new lighting improves things!

[b]RTX Off:[/b]

We've updated the screenshot section of the store page to reflect the new visuals, and rest assured, a new trailer is in the works, as well! We're only a few short weeks away from release, and we're working hard to fine tune and improve as much as we can before then. We hope you're as excited as we are!
